source.review: Full page at 150 and 300 dpi and exercise captions inspected. Source and rasterized Penrose SVGs compared side by side after tightening all four canvases.

verification.reuse: One identificationSourceStyle renders all four independent substances; scaled antipodal disk also renders.

limits: Figure 4.6 caption appears mathematically incomplete: {{(x,y)|x=y+m, where m is an integer}} names one subset rather than a partition. The supplied wording and graphic are preserved; no missing parameter or equivalence relation is silently introduced.
Original scan noise and heavier hatching are replaced by clean vectors and the shared subdued orange fill.

figures.math: The union of both complete opposite edges is collapsed into one class; interior points remain singletons.
figures.visual: Rectangle aspect, A/B/C/D corners and full diagonal hatching retained; no invented pointwise edge gluing.

figures.math: Antipodal boundary pairs are identified; every interior point has a singleton class.
figures.visual: Circular outline, complete hatching and sole center dot retained; no additional arrows or boundary markers.

figures.math: The literal caption denotes the single integer-difference locus. It does not form a partition of the plane, so no repaired quotient is asserted.
figures.visual: Hatched ambient coordinate window, x/y axes, origin and R² retained; no invented parallel lines.

figures.math: The entire polygon boundary is collapsed to one equivalence class; other points remain singletons.
figures.visual: Five-sided region, source proportions, full diagonal hatching and C label retained.
